product.name: Graf Carat Garden Comfort Rainwater Harvester Package
product.description: Designed for outdoor cleaning and irrigation purposes, the Garden Comfort Rainwater Harvesting system by Graf is ideal for collecting rainwater from the roof of your property and then feeding it into the underground tank via the downpipes. Available in various sizes, you can use the harvester for domestic or commercial use with the choice of either an A15 lid for pedestrian use or a B125 cast iron lid for light vehicular use.Before entering the underground tank, the water passes through a filter to remove debris, ensuring clear water for use. An underground pressure-sensitive pump is also installed. When a valve or tap is opened, the water is pumped under pressure until the valve is closed allowing the system to re-pressurise and turn off the power to the pump.Features & Benefits: Graf Carat Garden Comfort Rainwater Harvester PackageLightweight for easy handling and transportationEasy and safe to assembleA15 and B125 lid options and choice of harvester sizes availableEPDM used to profile sealings and ensure minimum life of 25 yearsConstant monitoring of production ensures consistent qualitySuitable for vehicle loading when a telescopic cast iron cover is usedTwo additional hose-lock connection extraction pointsFilter prevents leaves, moss and debris from travelling with the rainwater out of the tankFilter package 2 consists of an internal Universal Filter 3, an inflow stilling system for controlling the water inflow as well as a Spannfix connection sleeve, Rodent Guard and an Overflow siphon. The Integra Inox Submersible pump features an automatic start/stop function with a floating water extraction unit and protection against dry running.Please note: If you have an above-ground tank, you can use a pump to extract the rainwater. However, if the tank is underground, you'll need a pump to extract the rainwater. It's important to consider what you'll be using the harvested rainwater for, as this will determine whether you need a backup function for periods where little rainwater is collected.

product.name: Graf One2Clean Sewage Treatment Plant
product.description: Graf's One2Clean Sewage Treatment Plant, which will require a power source, is designed to treat wastewater so it is clean and safe enough to discharge into a nearby watercourse. With near-silent performance, odourless operation and a discreet design that features as little technology as possible, the low-maintenance One2Clean plant will only require emptying approximately every year.With various tank sizes to choose from within the range, One2Clean will provide efficient and cost-effective sewage treatment for five to eighteen people.Features & Benefits: Graf One2Clean Sewage Treatment PlantDesigned to treat wastewater so it is clean and safe enough to discharge into a nearby watercourseAvailable in various sizesNear-silent performanceOdourless operationDiscreet design with a flat cover that sits flush with the groundFeatures as little technology as possibleLow-maintenance - will only require emptying approximately every yearFully assembled upon delivery for easy installationPerfect for all groundwater environmentsPedestrian and vehicle loading covers available25-year shell warrantyThis range features covers that are available in different weight class options to suit your project requirements. Whether you need pedestrian loading or vehicle loading covers, the Graf One2Clean Sewage Treatment Plant will provide an efficient, low-energy consuming sewage treatment solution. The flat surface allows for flush ground installation and the adjustable height allows you to make small height corrections on-site.Please note: The sludge which builds up at the bottom of the tank must also be emptied in line with the manufacturer's instructions.The water discharged from the One2Clean packaged treatment plant must meet the relevant British Standard, which is BS EN 12566 for small sewage treatment plants and BS 6297:2007 for drainage fields.Numerous companies can dispose of the waste and they must be a registered waste carrier.

product.description:
Klaro E Professional sewage treatment plants by Graf are always a good choice. They are flexibly adapted to meet the stricter discharge values in water protection areas. No live parts need to be installed in the Klaro E Professional. Movement processes are created by three air lift pumps that are operated using a compressor which is built into the control.
The Graf Klaro E Professional wastewater treatment system does not need consistent integration of live technology in the tank. product.description: This Doubled Ended Square Leg/Plain Fascia/Reveal Liner has been manufactured to last and is available in a range of widths with a variety of colours featuring Freefoam patented Colormax technology and woodgrain finishes produced with market-leading Renolit Exofol with built-in Solar Shield Technology, reducing heat absorption and minimalizing profile temperature and expansion.Perfect for improving existing wood fascia boards without a full replacement and completely removing the original fascia boards, this fascia board is ideal for protecting your existing fascia system and providing a professional, clean finish with a stylish and modern appearance. With a smooth, hard-wearing, strong skin, this fascia board is coated with robust uPVC and has a strong PVC-UE foam 'core'. Made with extra Titanium Dioxide, this uPVC double-ended fascia board is protected from UV damage, so it looks good and lasts for longer, resisting discolouration with a 20-year guarantee for the white fascia board and a 10-year guarantee for the coloured fascia boards. This environmentally friendly solution is 100% lead-free.

product.name: Freeflow Half Round Plastic Gutter
product.description:
Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

product.name: Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain Pipe
product.description: This Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain Pipe is part of a sturdy and flexible dry-jointed pipework system that is easy to install and suited to various applications. It is lightweight yet durable, making it resistant to accidental external damage and vandalism, and eco-friendly with a recyclable cast iron structure.With a choice of ductile or stainless steel couplings, the complete soil and waste pipework system covers installation from pipework connection to stack to underground sewer connection. It is compatible with rainwater installations alongside Harmer Roof Outlets with pipes in lengths of 3m and diameters ranging from 50mm to 400mm. You can construct your system using the twin screw couplings. Socketless fixing between pipe and fittings is easy but secure without special installation equipment.Features & Benefits: Harmer SML Cast Iron Underground Drain PipeLightweight but strong cast ironHigh tensile strengthEasily assembled with socketless fixingResilient primer and epoxy coatings for low maintenanceRecyclable after useSystem suited to various applicationsThe pipes and fittings from this system are crafted from grey iron to DIN 1691 (exceeds BS 1452 Grade 150 ISO 185 Grade 15), while the couplings feature stainless steel and ductile cast iron constructions. The pipes are coated with a primer (minimum thickness of 40 µm) on their exteriors and an epoxy coating (minimum thickness of 120 µm) on their interiors. Fittings, however, are coated both externally and internally with an epoxy coating (minimum thickness 60 µm). Quick to assemble
100% recyclable

product.description:
The Freeflow square line gutter system includes a traditional square style gutter with a complete range of matching fittings to ensure a water-tight professional installation. The gutter is 114mm wide, 57mm deep and is available in lengths of 4m and 5m. All square line gutter system parts are available in white, black and brown. Square or round pipe systems may be fitted to the square line gutter system.Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

product.name: Freeflow Square Style Plastic Gutter External Stopened
product.description:
The Freeflow square line gutter system includes a traditional square style gutter with a complete range of matching fittings to ensure a water-tight professional installation. The gutter is 114mm wide, 57mm deep and is available in lengths of 4m and 5m. All square line gutter system parts are available in white, black and brown. The square line gutter is compatible with other square line rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Square or round pipe systems may be fitted to the square line gutter system.Freeflow is a range of innovative, high quality PVC-U rainwater systems that are the result of Freefoam’s culture of continuous innovation and investment in research and development. The Freeflow range has been designed to ensure both reliable, leak-free performance and quick installation. In addition, it is compatible with other rainwater systems with a range of adaptors. Freeflow products come in a range of standard colours including white, black and brown.
Each rainwater system is co-extruded with a white interior and a range of exterior colours - Freefoam’s new innovative solution to the problems associated with rapid heat absorption and expansion of gutters. Widely published test results show that while a white surface exposed to sunshine can absorb heat and attain a surface temperature 10ºC or more over the air temperature, dark surfaces can rise a further 30-40ºC and exceed the softening point of the PVC. On large capacity gutters with a large surface area facing the sun, this can be a particular problem. While the interior will be exposed to sunlight as normal, its absorption of heat from the sun and subsequent expansion along its width and length will be significantly reduced, thus dramatically decreasing the probability of any associated problems.

product.name: ACO Stainless Steel Pipe Increaser Coupling Concentric
product.description:
As part of a growing range of engineered drainage solutions, ACO PIPE® presents a wide range of socketed waste pipework systems in thin-wall stainless steel for above and below ground drainage applications.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel socketed pipe systems provide the modern metal alternative to PVC-u and cast iron soil and waste pipework.ACO PIPE® socketed stainless steel systems significantly reduces installation time and associated costs along with long term maintenance and care costs.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel pipework systems are manufactured from austenitic stainless steel in grades 304 and 316. All products are chemically pickled passivated for optimum durability and corrosion resistance.
Surface treatment by means of electropolishing or varnishing is available. Recognised for long service and its easily cleaned characteristics, stainless steel's hard, smooth surface provides efficient flow for water and waste products.
ACO PIPE® sockets are fitted with EPDM seals as standard for regular drainage applications above and below ground. For particularly aggressive chemical applications, 316 grade stainless steel with Viton® seals can be specified for the ultimate in system durability.

Easy installation
Highly corrosion resistant
Lightweight and easy to handle
Double sealed jointing system
Simple push-fit assembly
Low thermal expansion coefficient
No painting required
Aesthetically pleasing
Electro-polished option
Sustainable material
Hygienic

product.name: ACO Freedeck Galvanised Steel Fixed Height Shallow Channel
product.description:
ACO FreeDeck is an advanced roof and balcony drainage system combining line drainage with point drainage by using an open sided drainage channel system to collect and convey rainwater to drainage points within a raised or suspended deck structure.Rainwater is intercepted at 3 points:

Surface run-off
Percolation within the deck
Rainwater outlet positions

Manufactured in galvanised steel or stainless steel, ACO FreeDeck channel is simply laid directly onto the insulation layer or waterproofing membrane. Efficient drainage is provided where paving is required to be laid 'open or closed joint' improving safety for foot traffic and weathered protection of the building fabric.
Complying with national access regulations, ACO FreeDeck channels provide level access drainage in compliance with:

England and Wales Building Regulations ACCESS TO AND USE OF BUILDING: Approved Document M
Scottish Building Standards DOMESTIC AND NON DOMESTIC HANDBOOK: Section 4
Northern Ireland Building Regulations, DFP Technical Booklet R: 2006 ACCESS TO AND USE OF BUILDINGS: Section 7

Key Features
ACO FreeDeck is used for rainwater drainage and safe access in a variety of applications

Drainage for all types of suspended deck construction
A system that details into all types of flat roof finishes
Practical within all applications throughout building life
A drainage system that protects and maintains the building fabric

product.name: ACO 316 Stainless Steel Pipe Socket Plug with Clamp
product.description:
As part of a growing range of engineered drainage solutions, ACO PIPE® presents a wide range of socketed waste pipework systems in thin-wall stainless steel for above and below ground drainage applications.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel socketed pipe systems provide the modern metal alternative to PVC-u and cast iron soil and waste pipework.ACO PIPE® socketed stainless steel systems significantly reduces installation time and associated costs along with long term maintenance and care costs.
ACO PIPE® stainless steel pipework systems are manufactured from austenitic stainless steel in grades 304 and 316. All products are chemically pickled passivated for optimum durability and corrosion resistance.
Surface treatment by means of electropolishing or varnishing is available. Recognised for long service and its easily cleaned characteristics, stainless steel's hard, smooth surface provides efficient flow for water and waste products.
ACO PIPE® sockets are fitted with EPDM seals as standard for regular drainage applications above and below ground. For particularly aggressive chemical applications, 316 grade stainless steel with Viton® seals can be specified for the ultimate in system durability.
Key Features & Benefits:

Easy installation
Highly corrosion resistant
Lightweight and easy to handle
Double sealed jointing system
Simple push-fit assembly
Low thermal expansion coefficient
No painting required
Aesthetically pleasing
Electro-polished option
Sustainable material
Hygienic
